source: [curious] Our first stop... the Adventurer's Camp. [warmly] This is where Doddy's story begins — a Computer Science graduate from BINUS University, who never really stopped building. [proudly] Today, he's a Junior AI Engineer at Fanisin — teaching apps to see, to listen, and to talk back. From Jakarta... to people all over the world.
